title: Diamond Pattern
description:
Print a diamond pattern of stars with a maximum width of 5 (i.e., the widest row has 5 stars). The diamond is centered.

**Expected output:**
```
  *
 ***
*****
 ***
  *
```
hint: Split into top half (including middle) and bottom half. For row i of the top (1-indexed), print (n-i) spaces then (2*i-1) stars.
